The user wrote in Hebrew about the early culture in southern Mesopotamia. I think they're looking for the name of the Sumerian civilization, which is referred to in Hebrew as "התרבות השומרית." I’ll emphasize that it developed in cities like Uruk, Ur, and Aridu starting around the 4th millennium BCE. I want to keep my response concise, so I'll go with: "התרבות השומרית (השומרים), שהתפתחה בערים כמו אורוך, אור וארידו החל מן האלף ה-4 לפנה"ס."
[/Thinking]

התרבות השומרית (השומרים).
